places.name: Dodge City
places.note: After his new horse is crippled three days north, July walks back, buys another horse from a tipsy trader and leaves within the hour.

places.name: Arkansas River
places.note: July swims it walking back into Dodge, then recrosses heading north.

places.name: Republican River
places.note: Camped on a bluff near it, July is snakebitten and lies sick for days before crossing.
places.location_hint: July camps on a little bluff on its south side, nearly in sight of Nebraska

places.name: Nebraska
places.note: July rides into its browner plains, lonely and light-headed after the snakebite.

places.name: North Platte River
places.note: July reaches it and follows the wagon road west; Cholo rides out of it to meet him.

places.raw_name: a lone frame house south of the Platte
places.name: Clara's ranch
places.note: Clara feeds and beds the exhausted July, tells him Elmira passed through, and says the baby she calls Martin is his son.
places.location_hint: lone frame house half a mile south of the Platte on the only road along the river, about twenty miles from Ogallala, Nebraska

places.name: Ogallala
places.note: Twenty miles off; Cholo saw Dee Boot hanged there last week, and Clara once glimpsed Jake there.

places.name: Fort Smith
places.note: July's home; he recalls a merchant there who returned a day too late to see his dying wife.

places.name: Memphis
places.note: Where the Fort Smith merchant John Fisher was on business when his wife fell ill.

places.name: Arkansas
places.note: July introduces himself as coming from there.

groups.label: July Johnson
groups.hint: asleep in the girls' room at Clara's house

groups.label: Clara's household
groups.hint: at the ranch house on the Platte road
